messages:
emma-marketing: Hey runtime team — planning the webinar next Wed. Need a final set of benchmark numbers and a short methodology blurb we can show on slides. Can you confirm which model variants and quantization levels you ran? Also need 99th pct latencies for 1k concurrent qps. 

sam-runtime: Hi! We can provide that. Which exact workload? chat gen or batch embeddings? 

emma-marketing: Mostly streaming chat gen + embed for search. Focus on 2 sequence lengths: 64 tokens (short) and 512 (long). Embeds: 768-dim, 8k requests. 

nish-eng: Re: 99th pct — our infra collects p99 at per-shard level. For a clean slide, do you want p95, p99, and tail (p99.9)? p99.9 will be noisy. 

emma-marketing: p95 and p99 should be fine. If you can include p99.9 as 'measured, noisy' that's ok. We just need an honest narrative. 

zoe-qa: Also note that we had one known misconfig during the last run (KV cache disabled on quant-8). We should either rerun or annotate that in methodology. 

sam-runtime: Good catch, @zoe-qa. We will rerun quantized variants with KV cache on. ETA: ~4 hours for smoke, full sweep overnight. 

lewis-analytics: For the slide with cost/unit, please include the batch size and actual tokens/s per GPU. We can compute cost/token if you want. 

emma-marketing: Yes please include cost/token and model version hashes. We need a single line methodology: 'A/B runtimes on N GPUs, synthetic vs. replayed traffic' — can someone draft? 

sam-runtime: Draft: "Benchmarks run using replayed production traces (mix of short/long sequences), per-model variants (fp16, int8), with KV caching enabled. Metrics: throughput, p95/p99 latency, and tokens/sec measured at steady state." 

alex-product: LGTM. Add note: 'runs performed on Dedicated pools (g4dn-like) — specify exact instance types in appendix.' 

emma-marketing: Perfect. Could runtime push the CSVs and raw logs to the marketing S3 bucket once done? We'll link in the webinar deck. 

deploy-bot: build/bench-rerun triggered by @sam-runtime — job 78293 queued. 

sam-runtime: Will push artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/bench/1835007890/ and ping here when complete. 

emma-marketing: Thanks all — that'll let us finalize the slide copy and speaker notes. :tada:
